How does it work? Flow is Google's website that makes videos with AI; PhilCut cannot log in for you, so it does the groundwork:
1. « Make »: PhilCut puts the prompt (in English) on the clipboard and opens Flow in your browser.
2. In Flow: « New project », click in the text box, Ctrl+V to paste, then the arrow to generate (one to a few minutes).
3. On the video you like: Download button (MP4). The file arrives in the watched folder below (usually your Downloads).
4. PhilCut waits for this file (bottom bar, with elapsed time and « Stop »), then shows it to you: you watch it and choose to insert it at the red line, keep it in the media or discard it.

<b>Une musique a deux sortes de droits.<: Music has two kinds of rights. The work (the composition, the lyrics) is free 70 years after the death of its last author: the Dies irae, Mozart, Beethoven, Bizet are. The recording (a specific performance) has its own rights, those of the producer and performers: in France and the European Union, as a general rule, 70 years after its publication; a 1930s recording is therefore in principle free here, but not necessarily in the United States (there, those from 1925 have only been free since 2026). A Beethoven Symphony recorded in 2015 remains protected by its recording. Free to use: old recordings under these conditions, those under a free licence (Creative Commons, shown by the source) and what you have permission for. For a protected track, PhilCut can only take inspiration from its style (tempo, instruments, mood): the melody is never copied. YouTube's terms only allow downloading through its own means: by using yt-dlp, you take responsibility. When in doubt, do not publish.

How does it work? Flow is Google's website that makes videos with AI; PhilCut cannot log in for you, it does the groundwork (test of 9 November 2026):
1. « Make »: PhilCut copies the prompt (in English) to the clipboard and opens Flow in your browser.
2. In Flow: « + New project ». The first time, the settings icon (left of the arrow, bottom right): keep « Confirm before generating: Always », video 16:9, x1 (x2 costs double), model Veo 3.1 – Lite (the cheapest), then « Save ».
3. In « What do you want to create? »: Ctrl+V to paste, then the arrow. Flow announces the price in credits (Veo 3.1 Lite: 10 credits for 8 s, its only duration): « Approve » (never « Always approve »). Depending on demand, the shot waits in a queue for a few minutes.
4. Credits: click your photo at the top right; Flow gives 50 per day (about 5 Lite shots), reset every evening.
5. On the video: Download button (MP4 720p). The file arrives in the watched folder below (usually your Downloads).
6. PhilCut waits for this file (bottom bar, with elapsed time and « Stop »), then shows it to you: you watch it, and choose to insert it at the red line, keep it in the media or discard it. Its settings are kept: right-click on the shot › « Resume the creation ».
